hook: 字根 tend/tens＝伸、張——拉力場專管拉長與張力。（有別於 ten＝握持）
script: extend 往外伸；contend 伸拳競爭。distend 脹開；tense／tension 拉緊。intense 強度拉滿；ostensible 表面上伸出來給人看。attend 把注意力伸過去；pretend 假裝伸一套戲。extensive 範圍伸很廣；tendency 傾向往哪伸。

members.speakLineEn: Extend the follow-up window before claiming durability.
members.speakLineZh: 宣稱持久性前先延長追蹤窗。

members.speakLineEn: Authors contend that bias is bounded.

members.speakLineEn: Hype can distend expectations beyond evidence.
